notes.subject: maoto
notes.rationale: Seheberu se re 'o khubeka' feela; 'ka maoto' se ekeditswe ho hlalosa tsela ya haresa

notes.subject: a hae
notes.rationale: bokgacheng ha ho na sehlomathiso 'wa hae'; se ekeditswe ka Sesotho

notes.subject: יחפרו
notes.rationale: חפר e bolela 'ho bopa/ho hlahlola'; KJV 'he paweth' (haresa) kgahlanong le YLT 'they dig' (bongata)

notes.subject: נשק
notes.rationale: 'dibetsa' kapa 'ba entsweng dibetsa' (ba nang le dibetsa, jwalo ka KJV/ASV)

translation: O khubeka ka ⟨maoto⟩ sephatlalathing, mme a ikgantsha matleng a hae; o tswa ho ya kopana le dibetsa.
